reviewed_by: Codex focused review of supervisor task transcript formatting
reason: A saved subagent task is a user-role chat message. It was rendered as a plain paragraph while assistant and agent messages used safe Markdown. The selected component tests cover Markdown safety, exact code text, and disabled execution. The selected child-conversation browser case verifies inline code, ordered steps, long-path containment, navigation, and reload at desktop and mobile Chromium/WebKit widths. The real-Core edit case verifies persisted Markdown, reload, exact stored source, and the existing edit workflow.
exclusions: No full-suite approval was given. Python and native code are unchanged. The browser matrix uses emulated mobile devices; no physical device was available. Formatting does not use origin-sensitive browser APIs, so the real-Core persistence test uses loopback. Unrelated chat features and backend suites are excluded.
